source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-12

procedures.title: Door window glass: remove and install
steps: Take off the door trim panel.
Remove the window outer and inner seal assemblies.
Raise the window fully so the 2 sash screws line up with the access holes.
Remove the 2 sash screws on the horizontal guide channel, holding the nut with your other hand (see figure 30 in the manual).
Remove the 1 Phillips screw at the top of the channel assembly to free the stop.
Move the front and rear channel assemblies fully outboard for clearance.
Lift the window up and out, guiding the rollers through the inner door panel opening (see figure 31 in the manual).
If fitting new glass, remove the 2 pads with fasteners and the frame assembly (3 bolts through the glass, see figure 32 in the manual) and mount them on the new glass first.
Slide the glass into the door with its convex side facing outboard.
Fit and tighten the 2 sash bolt-and-nut assemblies through the horizontal guide channel and glass frame.
notes: Figures 18-20 (caulking application, windshield installation, cowl ventilator controls) are on this page.
